items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well, I like the guys in my group, actually. I love Greg Osby.

ctx.x: That piques your curiosity on the horizon or your admiration even?

Well, I like the guys in my group, actually. I love Greg Osby. He is, I think he’s unique. We do… I told you we, we feature Greg on Chelsea Bridge. So he comes out and he sorta just plays by himself for a while, and he plays this stunning stuff, for me. I never know what direction he’s going to go, and then he takes some pickup notes and we’re into this old Billy Strayhorn tune right away. And it just paints a whole different color to the bridge and… (laughs) Chelsea Bridge, I mean. So yeah, Greg, Greg’s playing…
then somebody else… Joey, I think. Joey had done the same thing ‘cause they… ‘cause Russell got to play with Ornette on that Sonny Rollins concert.
